entries.title: Psalms 26:1
segments: ¶<Of David.> O Lord, be my judge, for my behaviour has been upright: I have put my faith in the Lord, I am not in danger of slipping.

entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: Put me in the scales, O Lord, so that I may be tested; let the fire make clean my thoughts and my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 26:3
segments: For your mercy is before my eyes; and I have gone in the way of your good faith.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments: I have not taken my seat with foolish persons, and I do not go with false men.

entries.title: Psalms 26:5
segments: I have been a hater of the band of wrongdoers, and I will not be seated among sinners.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments: ¶I will make my hands clean from sin; so will I go round your altar, O Lord;

entries.title: Psalms 26:7
segments: That I may give out the voice of praise, and make public all the wonders which you have done.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: Lord, your house has been dear to me, and the resting-place of your glory.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Let not my soul be numbered among sinners, or my life among men of blood;

entries.title: Psalms 26:10
segments: In whose hands are evil designs, and whose right hands take money for judging falsely.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: But as for me, I will go on in my upright ways: be my saviour, and have mercy on me.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: I have a safe resting-place for my feet; I will give praise to the Lord in the meetings of the people.
